title: Binary content sent as a CBOR text string

source.note: composed: §7.1 lists String, Byte string, Array and Object as the CBOR content types and says binary uses a byte string directly, but it does not forbid a text string under a `binary` format. A peer that base64-encodes anyway, as the text fallback requires, produces exactly this. Composed as a negative-ish case: it decodes, and validate reports a Warning.

notes: This is one of the two cases where canonical_json is not a fixed point: the JSON wire cannot tell a byte string from a text string, so re-decoding the re-encoding yields bytes and no finding. A defensible alternative would be to base64-decode the text string here as the JSON wire does, which would make this case decode to bytes with no finding at all; the crate does not, because §7.1 gives the peer a byte string to use and a text string there is text.
